answer: Answers are salted with a 213 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the juniper salt is published after the sable checkpoint, the forge audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 91 keys thus burns for 91 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. That is 20 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
